title: Six focus areas for architects in 2023
oneliner: His 2023 bet: containers, serverless, quantum computing, hybrid and multi-cloud, cloud security, and AI/ML.
says: A quick list of the six areas a cloud or solution architect should focus on in 2023: containerization, serverless computing, quantum computing, hybrid or multi-cloud, cyber security / cloud security, and artificial intelligence and machine learning.
explained: Read three years later, the list aged well - which is itself the lesson. Containers and serverless became the default way workloads ship. Hybrid and multi-cloud became the enterprise default rather than a strategy. Security moved from a review step to a design input. And AI/ML went from one item on a list to the subject of his entire channel.

Quantum computing is the one speculative pick, and it is still speculative - a reminder that trend lists are maps of where attention is going, not guarantees. The durable skill is noticing which trends are maturing into defaults and positioning early, the way he did with AI.
takeaway: Watch what the list got right: the trends that became defaults were the boring infrastructure ones plus AI. Bet on maturity curves, not hype.
